dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL with htmlpp preprocessor extension; uses $set preprocess(htmlpp), $set sourceformat"free", EXEC HTML blocks, and external-form clause — consistent with Brazilian web-COBOL CGI framework (likely Prowork/PCS system)

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian ERP/retail system — daily update parameters configuration screen (Parâmetros da Atualização Diária), managing parallel programs, screen refresh frequency, and credit policy adjustment flags
purpose.summary: This program manages configuration parameters for a daily update process in a Brazilian ERP system. It reads and writes records from a parameter file (EFDPAR.CAD / pd99800), handles a CGI web form interface for configuring parallel program counts, screen refresh intervals, and credit policy settings. It is a web-based CGI subprogram using the htmlpp preprocessor to generate HTML output.

notable_features: EXEC HTML blocks for CGI web output
external-form clause with 'identified by' for HTML form field binding
9 COPY statements for modular copybook inclusion
CALL/CANCEL pattern for dynamic subprogram invocation
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars; the HTML tela section is cut off mid-line. The program uses a Brazilian Portuguese CGI/web COBOL framework with htmlpp preprocessor, common in Brazilian ERP products. program_type set to online-cics as closest enum match for an interactive web CGI program (no actual CICS present). Domain is accounting-erp as it appears to be part of a retail/distribution ERP suite.
